fields.rules: When played, look at the top card of the Fog.
Blocks first each round.
Your other keepers get +1 while this is in play.
When this leaves play, add 1 ember to any keeper.
Fast. Can act the round it is played.
At round start, remove 1 fog from the town.
Add 2 embers to a keeper.
Ignore the next Fog card this round.
Deal 2 damage to a Fog creature.
Prevent all damage to your keeper this round.
When played, draw a card.
Heal 1 damage from a card each round.
Blocks first each round.
Cannot be damaged by Fog events.
Fast. Can move to any place.
Flip at round end. Rising: draw two cards.
Flip at round end. Ebbing: put a card from hand on the deck.
Heal 2 damage from a card.
Return a Fog creature to the Fog deck.
Move a keeper to any place.
A keeper takes no damage until your next turn.
Creeps in at round start.
Hides the card below it.
Keepers here cannot gain embers.
Grows +1/+1 each round.
Every keeper discards a card.
Remove a lantern from play.
Flip when damaged. Rolling: 3/5.
Discard at round end. The town breathes again.
Deal 1 damage to every keeper.
Blocks the first Fog creature each round.
Once per round, reveal the next Fog card.
Keepers here heal 1 damage each round.
Keepers here can move to any place.
Store up to two cards here, face down.
Ring it to clear one fog from the town.
